michelle: Heads up — the Getting Started Python page's async example is failing for me.
nguyen: Which link?
michelle: https://docs.redwood.ai/getting-started/python — the 'Async client' snippet looks off. It's still using `Redwood()` instead of the async client. I copied this: 
```python
from redwood import Redwood
import os

async def main():
    client = Redwood(os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
    resp = await client.chat.create(model="gptx", input="hello")
    print(resp)
```
michelle: Running it errors with: `TypeError: 'Redwood' object is not awaitable` (stack trace points to client.chat.create awaiting a sync client).
samir: Ah — that's the old sync class. We renamed the async one to `RedwoodClient` in v0.9 and updated most pages, but looks like this page slipped through.
devx-bot: Created issue #2314 in docs (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/2314) and attached the failing snippet. PR preview: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2314/files
nguyen: Also noticed the 'Python SDK reference' link in the sample-app README 404s — it points to /reference/python which now redirects to a legacy slug. I hit that when updating samples.
michelle: Quick local fix that works: 
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os

async def main():
    async with RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY']) as client:
        resp = await client.chat.create(model="gptx", input="hello")
        print(resp)
```
michelle: That runs fine. Added a small comment about sync vs async usage.
samir: I'll merge the docs PR with the minimal fix. We should also add a migration checklist item for scanning repos for `from redwood import Redwood` and replacing with the correct client.
docops: Tagging @michelle for a quick review once the PR is ready :eyes: 
michelle: One UX ask: can we add snippet execution to docs CI so these regressions get caught? Even a lightweight runner in a sandbox would save folks.
samir: Good idea — filing a follow-up RFC/issue to prototype snippet CI and wire it into docs pipeline. Reference #2314 in the RFC.
nguyen: I'll leave a note in the sample-app repo to update links after the docs PR merges.
michelle: Thanks all! :thumbsup:
